title: NestJS GraphQL Rate Limiting
author: Zoha
abstract: Layered rate-limiting and demand-control guide for NestJS GraphQL (code-first) applications, designed for AI agents and LLMs. Covers the one-time wiring (a global ThrottlerModule, the GraphQL-aware guard, a shared storage, one kill switch, fail-open behaviour, file placement), how to choose the limit unit (per operation rather than per HTTP POST, cost- or complexity-based), depth and cost control (depth-limit and query-complexity validation rules, self-referential depth, breadth and alias caps, introspection and persisted queries), field-level control (per-field cost weights, list multipliers, hot-field budgets), the declarative decorator surface (@RateLimit/@SkipRateLimit/@RateLimitCost and named windows), client identity (verified user over API key over tenant over IP, real client IP behind Cloudflare and other proxies, anonymous fallback), edge/Cloudflare deployment (defense in depth, CF-Connecting-IP trust, Cloudflare rate-limiting rules and the Workers Rate Limiting binding, Durable Objects versus KV for exact counters), error and observability shape (GraphQL 429 errors with extensions, RateLimit and Retry-After headers, metrics and a per-request trace), testing on outcomes with an in-memory store and frozen time, and the driver/version reality across Express, Fastify/Mercurius and Apollo v4/v5.
